sources.title: Jung et al. (2018), RustBelt: Securing the Foundations of the Rust Programming Language, POPL
sources.limitations: Soundness of a modeled subset and obligations for unsafe abstractions; not a proof of arbitrary Rust applications.

sources.title: Qin et al. (2020), Understanding memory and thread safety practices and issues in real-world Rust programs, PLDI
sources.limitations: Observed unsafe and concurrency bugs in selected projects; not population-wide prevalence.

sources.title: Evans, Campbell & Soffa (2020), Is Rust Used Safely by Software Developers?, ICSE
sources.limitations: Unsafe code can be reached transitively; historical ecosystem sample, not a current rate.

sources.title: Jung et al. (2020), Stacked Borrows: An Aliasing Model for Rust, POPL
sources.limitations: Aliasing model and optimization justification; not the final normative language specification.

sources.title: Bae et al. (2021), Rudra: Finding Memory Safety Bugs in Rust at the Ecosystem Scale, SOSP
sources.limitations: Static analysis detects subtle unsafe defects; no guarantee of completeness.

sources.title: Jung et al. (2026), Miri: Practical Undefined Behavior Detection for Rust, POPL
sources.limitations: Dynamic UB detection for executed paths with platform/API limitations; passing tests do not prove soundness.

sources.title: Understanding and Detecting Real-World Safety Issues in Rust (2024), IEEE TSE 50(6)
sources.limitations: Memory bugs, concurrency bugs and unintended panics motivate explicit failure-path tests; selected projects.

sources.title: Rust Reference: Behavior considered undefined
sources.limitations: Reference for UB restrictions; list not exhaustive.

sources.title: Rust API Guidelines
sources.limitations: Naming, interoperability, documentation and API design conventions; not a formal proof.

sources.title: The Rust Programming Language: Error Handling
sources.limitations: Recoverable versus unrecoverable errors; policy below is stricter than language requirements.

sources.title: Cargo Book: Manifest format
sources.limitations: Edition, rust-version, metadata and manifest configuration.

sources.title: Cargo Book: Continuous Integration
sources.limitations: Build and test in CI; target coverage must follow application support.

sources.title: Clippy documentation
sources.limitations: Lint rules catch classes of mistakes; not a correctness proof.

sources.title: RustSec Advisory Database
sources.limitations: Known advisories and lockfile auditing; unknown vulnerabilities remain.

sources.title: Rust Fuzz Book
sources.limitations: Coverage-guided and structure-aware fuzzing; finite budget cannot establish absence of defects.

sources.title: Rustfmt
sources.limitations: Canonical formatting tool; pin toolchain for reproducibility.
